name: Nakagawa Nanari
source: Nanari has a pretty short and petite body for her age. She has a faint admiration and love for the protagonist, but she cannot let him know of her feelings because of her introverted personality. Nanari is a klutz and her specialty is to fall frequently even in the absence of any obstacles in her way. Nanari's house is a flower shop and she helps her mother to work there as a florist.
